headline: Liverpool's Barcola Pursuit Stalls, Arsenal Linked
paragraphs: Bradley Barcola's move from Paris Saint-Germain to Liverpool has stalled. Sky Transfers reports that talks between the two clubs proved difficult to complete, and BBC Gossip separately says Liverpool are yet to agree a fee — two different newsrooms describing the same impasse. Sky Transfers also relayed newspaper reports floating Arsenal as a possible rival bidder for Barcola; that is paper talk, not a reported approach, and nothing else in the feed corroborates Arsenal's interest.

At Newcastle, Bruno Guimaraes said goodbye to fans in what he called the 'toughest decision', per Sky Transfers, though the report does not name his next club. BBC Gossip had reported Arsenal and Newcastle agreeing a fee for Guimaraes in late July, then described Arsenal as only opening talks for him days later — accounts that do not fully line up. No item in the feed confirms Arsenal have completed a signing.

Manchester City are reported by Sky Transfers to have agreed a deal for goalkeeper Rulli, with no further detail given, and separately to have rejected an initial Barcelona bid for Rodri as far too low. Liverpool, meanwhile, are said by Sky Transfers to have agreed a loan move for Barcelona defender Ronald Araujo, with a medical described as imminent. Both are single-outlet reports, unlike the Barcola situation above, which two separate newsrooms independently addressed.
